mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000, the labor market's dual signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% over two months signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO growth and SPX returns falls below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $50 billion over one month indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of months with RSAFS growth > $50 billion.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2% over three months, the dual signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE below 4% with PAYEMS growth stable (±50,000) signals a balanced labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST growth exceeding 10% over two months, coupled with RSAFS growth over $30 billion, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST 2-month growth > 10% and RSAFS 1-month growth > $30 billion
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances.
